record_type_quote: This study examines what would the outcome be if a methodology similar to that used for the MDGs were applied to the formulation of the post-2015 development goals (Post-2015DGs), identifying those targets arising from UN summits and conferences since the declaration of the MDGs, and aggregating them into goals.
reasoning: Original policy-document analysis applying an earlier goal-construction method to a later period; it does not re-test a specific published empirical finding.
